card.what: Low-profile aluminium-framed deck hatch: flanged frame screwed to the deck, black gasket, smoked acrylic pane in an aluminium lid band, hinge knuckles with pins on one edge, two lever handles under the pane
card.boats: J/22 hero fore hatch (360 x 560 mm, hinge forward); light J/22 layout; Catalina 22, Corsair 880 and Catalina 30 (build_fleet.py)
card.distance: arm's reach from the cabin top; the cabin-top camera passes over it
card.before: kit HatchFwd from bk_parts (Oct 2026): a flat frame slab, a lid slab, two block hinges and two loop handles standing on top of the lid; on the J/22 hero, two boxes

references.url: low-profile hatch listings (Lewmar Low Profile and Ocean, Vetus Magnus, Bomar): 30-40 mm overall height, flanged extruded aluminium frame, smoked acrylic 10-12 mm, handles inside, hinges on one edge
references.note: numbers only; no square-on photo used, so no outline check

references.use: the J/22's cabin top (IMG_9224, Bean's dock photo, project files only: it shows people elsewhere in the frame)
references.note: the hatch's position is still a GUESS: the photo shows a raised white panel aft of the mast and no clear hatch ahead of it

sizes.name: Length along X (hinge to handle edge) for the J/22 build
sizes.source: J/22 hero opening 0.32 m plus 40 mm frame, plus the hinge knuckles (GUESS on the hatch size)

features.text: Screwed-down flange with a rolled edge, countersunk screws every 85 mm
Sloping extruded wall up to a gasket seat
Black gasket line between frame and lid
Aluminium lid band round the pane, about 14 mm across the top
Thick smoked acrylic pane standing a few mm proud
Two hinge knuckles with pins on one short edge, standing past the frame
Two lever handles with bosses and cam tongues under the pane (seen through the smoke and from below)
Made-up maker's plate on the band (TERNWAY, no real brand)

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
